blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The municipal government of Bansud has suspended work in government offices and classes in all public and private schools on Monday, Nov. 16, in commemoration of the 76th founding anniversary of Oriental Mindoro. In a memorandum Sunday, Municipal Mayor Ronaldo Morada ordered the suspension of work and classes to allow government employees, students, teachers and the public to participate in the province’s anniversary celebration. The province marked its 76th founding anniversary on Sunday. The suspension covers all departments and offices of the Bansud municipal government, concerned government agencies, and public and private schools at all levels […]...
